about: Punch list #217, Show it, don't say it: every prototype and build, one row each. The mock-up page's bars and `npm run proto -- <id>` both read this file. kind: proto (a draft PR behind a per-person switch, off by default; the door shows today's look above the shape on ?sbs=1), build (a PR with auto-merge armed), shipped (on main; the door is on main). as: dev when the door signs in through /dev-login (needs .env.local), none for a portal or sample page. port: the prototype's own dev-server port, so the page's open-it link is right once it runs.
